data.name: 深渊旅人
data.detailed_description:
An ordinary rural boy, with an unexpected rescue, opens the prelude to a conspiracy to overthrow the world. Abyssal Traveler is a traditional turn based role-playing game that emphasizes story and character development. You will lead the protagonist Sauron and the mysterious girl Yuna on an adventure through a vast world, uncovering the ultimate secret hidden between the kingdom and the gods through growth and decision-making.

[Core Features]

🎭 Immersive storyline experience

-Experience a thrilling journey from ordinary to legendary, and your choices will influence the direction of the story.

-Through a large number of rich side quests, gain a deep understanding of every corner and character's past in this world.

⚔️ Classic and strategic turn based battles

-Adopting classic command based combat: flexibly using skills, attacks, and items to defeat enemies.

-As you level up, learn powerful new skills and customize your combat style.

👥 Recruiting and cultivating unique partners

-Encounter and recruit partners with diverse abilities: experienced hunters, fierce warriors, sacred church priests, etc.

-Focus on cultivating partners based on their different characteristics, strategically match team formations, and deal with various powerful monsters and bosses.

🌍 Explore diverse fantasy worlds

-Embark on an adventurous journey through dense virgin forests, magnificent monasteries, sandy deserts, and other unique regions.

[Main role]

-Soren: A sunny and determined rural boy who bravely ventures into the unknown world with a sword and shield to protect his loved ones.

-Yuna: An amnesiac girl with a mysterious background, possessing powerful magic. Her memory is the key to solving all puzzles.
